notes.title: 2025.3.14 Spring sale Update
notes.content:
1. New Dungeon: Bronze Echoes
(Unlocked after completing all explorations, accessible through the Crystal Ball dialogue)
(Includes 19 new artifacts, 12 new monsters, and 10 new scenes)

2. New Dungeon: Endless Abyss
(Unlocked after completing Bronze Echoes, accessible through the Crystal Ball dialogue)
(Can be re-entered to farm resources)

3. Background Gameplay
The game can now run in the background.

notes.title: 2025.2.11Update
notes.content:
BUG Fixes
Fixed the bug where the expansion was invisible.
Fixed the issue of non - support for large resolutions. A temporary solution has been implemented, and further optimization will be carried out later.
Fixed the bug where the character got stuck in a tree underground.
Fixed the bug in the "Si Yi" mission.
Fixed the text bug in the prosperity assessment.
Fixed the bug that occurred after reaching combo 600.
Fixed the achievement bug.
Fixed the problem with cloud saves.

Game Optimization:
Added guidance for standing signs.
Added red dot prompts for obtaining new items and new decorations.
Increased the number of crystal charging items for prosperity level - up.
Added a disappearing animation for the interaction of exploration artifact fragments.
Added the display of NPC head icons when there are plot options.

notes.title: "Museum No. 9" demo update announcement (V1.0.0.001)

tags.feature: 1. The shop opening skills are changed to be configurable before the shop opening;
2. The unlocking and upgrading of skills are changed to consume emotional imprints;
3. The shop opening task is changed to a fixed level task;
4. The decoration bonus effect is changed from probability to number;
7. All levels are changed to challenge successfully and can still be entered
8. The way to obtain the fragments of the artifacts in the adventure dungeon has been changed to treasure hunting, and a fixed number of fragments can be obtained in each level;
9. After finding the crystal fragments underground, there is no need to consume the imprint to activate its effect;

tags.bug: 1. Fixed the bugs related to item production and order submission;
2. Fixed the bug of setting the non-game window to full screen;
3. Fixed the bug of the artifact task;
4. Fixed various other bugs submitted by the curator;

tags.balance_change: 6. The production formula and material acquisition are slightly adjusted;
10. The difficulty of exploring the crystal challenge has been reduced;

notes.title: "Museum No. 9" event: comments and add to the wish list to get a game key！
notes.content:
Hello, friends who follow "Museum No. 9"!
In order to let everyone better experience the domestic independent game "Museum No. 9" we made, the producer will give you benefits! [u]Follow "Museum No. 9" and add to the wish list, comment on this post[/u], after the game is launched, [u]Randomly draw players in the comment area[/u] to give this game's [u]key[/u]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404170/_/

[h3]Participation method: [/h3]
[u]Follow[/u], [u]Comment[/u], [u]Add to wishlist[/u]

[h3]Participants: [/h3]
For every 100 people in the comment area, 5 more players will be selected to receive game keys.
If the number of people in the comment area is less than 100 at the beginning, 5 players will still be selected to receive game keys.

[b]Event start time: [/b]July 5, 2024

[b]Event end time: [/b]Game launch date (expected in the fourth quarter of 2024)

[h5]Everyone is welcome to actively participate! [/h5]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/56adec7e32e6aca676c3c47ccab0bc9d4cd6d634.jpg[/img]
[h2]Game Introduction:[/h2]
The game takes place in an era when human civilization is dying. You will run an "Old World" museum in a magical civilization that is reborn from the ashes. The game is an independent game of [b]simulation management + Rogue[/b]. You will simulate running a museum during the day, and [rogue exploration in the wild at night to obtain materials and dig up artifacts.

[h3]Game features: [/h3]
[h5]●Free museum construction[/h5]
——Rich furniture system, various styles for you to choose
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/38c54e5aac485a925f8459b93f0b23f04ae1fa4f.jpg[/img]
[h5]●Cultural relics restoration[/h5]
——Collecting cultural relics fragments and restoring them, passing on the torch is a great achievement
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/265a4e577b6a95792c8b17e0d7b3adc5bed422f9.jpg[/img]
[h5]●Simulation business[/h5]
——Rationally plan routes and skills to get more rewards and unlock scale
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/d031fd20ef458998535b39e117f4c0c04e2df061.jpg[/img]
[h5]●Material production[/h5]
——Special furniture and handicraft production, help museum construction and operation
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/d1db94349d948bd7f86a98ad588cbf870163f606.jpg[/img]
[h5]●Adventure mode[/h5]
——Light rogue mode night adventure, dig more materials and artifacts
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/a2992c97f90f1a54dfc9cef1e57acb52f7efa86f.jpg[/img]
[h5]●Specialized characters[/h5]
——Specialized NPCs help with management, making the simulation journey colorful
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/77677d9200889cb5419e2947306027e838df3058.jpg[/img]
[h5]●Room interface[/h5]
——Unique selection interface, where a variety of magic facilities gather
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/f66dde83577a2a5ff42c61d1f9c7459bc8e54a30.jpg[/img]
[h5]The game has many fun features waiting for you to explore! [/h5]

[h3]Contact us: [/h3]
[list]
[*] QQ group: [url=https://qm.qq.com/q/OkCedSbc4O]527313091[/url]
[*] B station: [url=https://space.bilibili.com/105186808?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0]B station Yaoyi studio[/url]

[/list]
[h5]The game demo is now open for trial play. Welcome everyone to experience it. If you have any questions, please contact us! [/h5]
[h5][u]Don't forget to follow and add it to the wish list, comment on this post to participate in the event and draw the game key! [/u]I hope everyone can have fun playing our game~[/h5]
